item.title: I like my low resolutions crunchy
item.author: invalid@example.com (sn00zer)
item.dc:creator: sn00zer
item.content:encoded: Let the resolution get crunchy. I want to be able to chew it like a potato chip. I don't want some smoothed over blob, gimme the crunch. The crunch is texture, the crunch is implied detail that isn't there. The crunch is life. Related, God did not intend for games built in 1997 with 1997 assets to be in 4k. Let that crunch make you believe you are seeing a highly textured detailed scenes, not the barren wasteland a game becomes when you crank the resolution and no CRT filtering.
